Anna Katharine Green, The Sword of Damocles.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anna-katharine-green/the-sword-of-damocles

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anna Katharine Green, the annotator and author, died 1935 (citizenship: United States).

First publication of the text used: 1881 (SE colophon: 'The Sword of Damocles was published in 1881 by Anna Katharine Green.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1881, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1976.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts; possible countries: United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1935, so the work is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2006.
